title: SWF: DoInitAction for symbol initialization
description: Symbols with linkage.exportForActionScript=true and a className should emit DoInitAction (tag 59) in frame 1 to register the class: DoInitAction body = AS2 bytecode for Object.registerClass('ClassName', ClassName). Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts for 'DoInitAction', 'tag 59', 'registerClass'. If already implemented, add tests. If missing, implement it: after ExportAssets, for each exported symbol with className, emit DoInitAction with Object.registerClass bytecode.
